question: Who has been appointed as the 'UPI Safety Ambassador' by the National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI) to enhance safety awareness on digital payment platforms in November 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pankaj Tripathi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Pankaj Tripathi has been appointed as the 'UPI Safety Ambassador' by the National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI) in November 2023.
 
• The initiative aims to enhance safety awareness regarding digital payments and the Unified Payments Interface (UPI) ecosystem.
 
• As an ambassador, Pankaj Tripathi will promote safe transaction practices and educate users about fraud prevention methods.
 
• NPCI is focusing on leveraging the popularity and trusted image of the actor to reach a broader audience.
 
• This campaign is part of NPCI's ongoing efforts to ensure secure and reliable digital payments in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Unified Payments Interface (UPI):**

 
 
• UPI is a real-time payment system developed by NPCI that facilitates instant money transfers between bank accounts via a mobile platform.
 
• Launched in 2016, it has revolutionized digital transactions in India, enabling seamless payments across businesses and individuals.
 
• UPI supports various services such as QR code payments, bill payments, and peer-to-peer money transfers.
 
• It is supported by major banks and payment platforms, making it one of the most widely used payment systems in India.
 
 
 
• **NPCI (National Payments Corporation of India):**
 
 
• NPCI is an umbrella organization for operating retail payment systems in India, established in 2008.
 
• It is responsible for implementing innovative payment systems like UPI, Bharat Bill Payment System (BBPS), and RuPay cards.
 
• NPCI works under the guidance of the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) and Indian Banks' Association (IBA).
 
• The organization aims to promote robust and secure payment infrastructure in India.
 
 
 
• **Digital Payment Safety Tips:**
 
 
• Always use strong passwords and enable two-factor authentication for payment apps.
 
• Verify recipient details before transferring funds to avoid fraudulent transactions.
 
• Avoid sharing sensitive information like PINs or OTPs with anyone.
 
• Regularly update payment apps to benefit from improved security features.
 
 
 
• **Fraud Prevention in UPI:**
 
 
• Be cautious of phishing attempts and fraudulent apps claiming to offer UPI services.
 
• Report suspicious activities or unauthorized transactions to your bank or payment platform immediately.
 
• Educate yourself about common scams such as fake QR codes or fraudulent payment requests.
 
• NPCI has introduced features like transaction limits and real-time alerts to enhance security.
